name: place_order
description: Place a trading order in the demo order book. MARKET orders fill immediately at the simulated market price and mutate real portfolio positions; LIMIT orders fill only if marketable, otherwise stay OPEN. Always confirm details with the user before calling.

order_type.description: One of: MARKET, LIMIT, STOP, STOP_LIMIT; Default: MARKET

limit_price.description: Limit price for LIMIT/STOP_LIMIT orders; 0 for MARKET (Default: 0)

name: cancel_order
description: Cancel an OPEN order in the demo order book by order ID.

name: get_order_status
description: Get the current status and fill details of an order by order ID.

name: get_trade_history
description: Get recent order/trade history for a portfolio with buy/sell value and commission summary (max 90 days).
